descricao_original: A cross section of a portion of a skeletal muscle fiber lies adjacent to a capillary. Note the large numbers of mitochondria, as well as myofibrils composed of myofilaments. Nuclei are located around the periphery of the fiber just beneath the sarcolemma. 12,000x
